description: Test file for the httpservice package, containing unit tests for HTTP client behavior, proxy handling, IP validation, and user-agent setting.

methods.name: TestHTTPClient
methods.description: Tests HTTP client behavior with insecure connections and IP/host checks.

methods.name: TestHTTPClientWithProxy
methods.description: Tests HTTP client with proxy configuration and IPv6 URL handling.

methods.name: TestDialContextFilter
methods.description: Tests dial context filtering based on IP and hostname restrictions.

methods.name: TestUserAgentIsSet
methods.description: Verifies that the user-agent header is correctly set in requests.

methods.name: TestIsReservedIP
methods.description: Checks if IP addresses are correctly identified as reserved.

methods.name: TestIsOwnIP
methods.description: Checks if IP addresses are correctly identified as local or not.

methods.name: TestSplitHostnames
methods.description: Tests splitting of hostnames from configuration strings.

methods.name: TestGetProxyFn
methods.description: Tests proxy URL determination based on environment variables and URL parsing.
